name: DOM-AI
summary: DOM-AI, also known as 4,7-dimethoxy-5-methyl-2-aminoindane, is a putative serotonergic psychedelic of the 2-aminoindane family and cyclic analogue of DOM. It was first described in the scientific literature by David E. Nichols and colleagues in 1974.

pharmacology.text: DOM-AI, also known as 4,7-dimethoxy-5-methyl-2-aminoindane, is a putative serotonergic psychedelic of the 2-aminoindane family and cyclic analogue of DOM.

uses.en: It is used only in laboratory research and is not a medicine.
uses.zh: 它僅用於實驗室研究，並不是藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它仅用于实验室研究，并不是药物。

fact.en: DOM-AI ties the side chain of DOM back into a ring, making an aminoindane. This kind of ring-locking is used to learn which shape of a flexible drug fits its receptor.
fact.zh: DOM-AI 把 DOM 的側鏈連回成環，形成胺基茚滿。這種把結構鎖成環的方法，可以用來了解一個可彎曲的藥物以什麼形狀與受體結合。
fact.zhHans: DOM-AI 把 DOM 的侧链连回成环，形成胺基茚满。这种把结构锁成环的方法，可以用来了解一个可弯曲的药物以什么形状与受体结合。
